player_prompt.intro:
U n'wi {player_id} eka **Ultimate Tic Tac Toe**.
Nyika xivangelo xo wena tanihi **[macro  micro]** (tinomboro timbirhi 0-8):
• *macro*  = i mini-bodi leyi u tirhisanaka eka yona
• *micro* = i skweya leyi u tirhisanaka eka yona eka mini-bodi
Xikombiso `[7 8]` ➜ weka xivangelo xo wena eka mini-bodi ya 7, skweya ya 8, kutani
xongamela mukwini wa wena ku tirhisa eka mini-bodi ya 8 ku landzela.

U n'wi `{symbol}`.

invalid_move.wrong_format: Ku rhurha ku fanele ku va hi xivumbeko xa [macro micro] na tinomboro 0-8.
invalid_move.out_of_range: Tinhlayo ta kona ti fanele ku va exikarhi ka 0 na 8.
invalid_move.index_out_of_range: Xiphephana lexi nge micro_board, row kumbe col xi le handle ka ndhawu leyi faneleke.
invalid_move.cell_occupied: Se ku ni munhu la tshamaka exitokisini xa mina.
invalid_move.wrong_micro_board: Mutlangi u fanele a tlanga eka bodo leyitsongo leyi landzelaka.
invalid_move.micro_board_won: Bodo ya swithongwana ana se yi hluriwile.

game_action.played: Mfiri {player_id} u tirele ku micro board {macro_idx}, seli {micro_idx} (xihloko {row}, kolona {col}). Mfiri {opponent_id} a fanele ku tirha kona hi {nxt_txt}.

outcome.win: Mutlangi {player_id} u hlula eka Ultimate Tic Tac Toe!
outcome.draw: Ntlangu wu ve na ku ringana!
